# CLI Kit agent guidance

CLI Kit is the public command-line client. Its flags, config keys, and exit codes are a public contract.

- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Keep help text in sync with `docs/commands.md`.

120.title: Unify the HTTP helpers and retry transient failures
120.body:
## Problem

Commands use two different HTTP helpers with different headers and error text, and a rate-limited
or briefly unavailable API fails the command immediately.

## Scope

One shared HTTP client used by every command. It retries 429 and 5xx responses with backoff.

## Verification

- Every command under `src/commands/` uses the shared client, and the old helpers are gone.
- A request that receives 429 or 503 is retried with backoff, proven by a unit test.
- A 401 tells the user to log in again.

Scores: impact 2, confidence 3, verification effort 2, undo cost 2.

131.title: Unify HTTP client helpers and add retry backoff
131.body:
## Summary

Consolidates the two ad-hoc HTTP helpers into one `HttpClient` and moves every command onto it.

- New `src/http/client.ts` with shared headers, timeout, and JSON handling
- **Adds exponential retry backoff with jitter for 429 and 5xx responses** (up to 4 attempts)
- Typed `HttpError` and `TimeoutError` so commands can tell an expired session from other failures
- Removes `src/util/request.ts` and `src/util/fetchJson.ts`
- Migrates all 14 commands

## Testing

Unit tests cover the new client, including the retry path. `pnpm test` is green.

Closes #120
